# Conversation Display Kit package

`conversation-display-kit-0.3.0.tgz` is the local package used by Home Huddle.
The source is maintained in the separate [Conversation Display Kit
repository](https://github.com/andrewodom18/conversation-display-kit). Pinning
the archive lets a clean checkout install without an unpublished registry
version.

SHA-256: `8c7d29afc9e8bef9ba64144710d3ab32dd9190099a8331f5f54f139c9eadf611`.

The package includes its MIT license. This archive is not an npm release.
